verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Airbyte hosts a working llms.txt at docs.airbyte.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a summary of the product, and Airbyte also documents MCP servers for agent-oriented docs/connectivity (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, etc.), showing deliberate agent-oriented documentation. missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of agents actually using llms.txt successfully, and no evidence of broader agent-native doc structuring beyond the single llms.txt file.
